text:
amelia: FYI Citrine Labs (acct CL-242) is past due on INV-004921 for $62,450. They just asked via email for a 50% up-front + remaining balance over 6 months. CC on file declined when we retried.

billing-bot: Dunning notice #2 sent to billing@citlin.com. Retry scheduled in 48h. Last card auth result: decline code 05.

diego: Can we confirm charges? large usage line or subscription? any anomalous spikes?

amelia: Invoice breakdown pasted below. Looks usage-heavy.

```
INV-004921:
- Annual platform fee: $18,000
- Overages (embeddings + gen): $44,500
- Credits applied: -$50
Total: $62,450
```

ravi: Overages are the bulk. I checked event logs 126k tokens/day around 2025-10-28 to 2025-11-05. Client mentioned they onboarded a partner connector. Could be misconfig.

lin: If it's a misconfig causing repeated high calls, we should push for a partial credit. What's our typical stance for partner-induced spikes?

megan: From legal: we can offer a payment plan but any permanent write-off >25% needs GC sign-off and VP Finance approval. Settlement addendum required for any deviation.

amelia: Operational ask: do we accept 50% now and six monthly payments, or propose an alternative (e.g., 30% now + 5 installments + audit window)?

diego: If they truly had a partner feed misconfigured, I'd be comfortable with 20% credit on the overage portion conditional on reconfiguration. That changes the math: 20% of $44.5k = $8.9k credit. New balance ~$53.55k.

ravi: Collections note: if we push to collections, typical recovery is 40-60% but takes months and costs ~8-12% in fees. With this customer, prior payments prompt, so risk of full default seems moderate.

billing-bot: Payment link generation blocked due to failed CC auth. Manual ACH/wire recommended.

megan: I'll prepare a settlement addendum template that includes: payment schedule, acknowledgement of debt, confidentiality clause, and express revert-to-full-balance on missed installment. Also include a clause denying future disputes on the charged period.

amelia: Proposed response to Citrine: We can do 40% upfront + remaining split over 5 months, or 30% + 6 months if they want a longer runway. Any permanent credits require brief technical audit confirming partner misconfig within 10 days. Addendum must be signed. Also require ACH/wire.

citrine-contact (external): Can we get 30% now and the rest in 6 months? Also asking if you can waive late fees. CFO is traveling, asking for a two-week window to sign.

lin: We should be firm on timeline. Two weeks slows cash and increases risk. Could permit 30% within 7 days + signed addendum, otherwise we escalate.

megan: Legal will not waive the miss-repayment revert clause. Late fees waiver can be considered if they accept the audit credit cap.

ravi: Operational ask to Amelia: If they do 30% today, what's the follow-up process? set up recurring ACH, add account flag, and schedule an account review at 90 days. If any miss, auto-notify collections.

amelia: I'm OK with conditional 30%/7 days + signed addendum; require audit request within 10 days to qualify for any overage credit. I'll draft the message and payment instructions.

diego: One more ask: please require a primary contact who will authorize the partner change logs so we can verify the misconfig quickly. Helps limit dispute window.

amelia: Good call. I'll include that.

billing-bot: Manual payment page created: https://payments.redwood.ai/manual/CL-242/INV-004921 1 link expires in 10 days.

amelia: Sending client reply now with two options and addendum attached. Will update when payment lands.

megan: Uploaded addendum template to /legal/settlements/drafts/ and DMed Amelia.

ravi: Flagging account for 90-day review and stress test if plan accepted.

amelia: Thanks team. I'll close out once cleared or escalate to collections after the 7-day window. :white_check_mark:
